title: Negative neutrino mass or negative dark energy? (Kibris, Elbers, Akarsu, Di Valentino)
efc_relevance: Systematic exploration of dark-energy models that allow ρ_DE < 0 at intermediate redshift; ΛsCDM sign-switching cosmological constant uniquely recovers a positive Σm_ν compatible with DESI DR2 + CMB + SNe. Directly maps onto EFC's L2→L3 transition where the entropic source term T(a) can change sign — the paper provides the falsifiable cosmographic signature (sign-switch redshift, ΔΩ_DE amplitude) EFC must match without requiring negative neutrino mass.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger and Predictions Ledger as sign-switching DE constraint; cross-reference framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001 and EFC L2→L3 T(a) sign-flip prediction in WP1; required cosmographic-fingerprint row (z_switch, ΔΩ_DE) in Predictions Ledger so EFC vs ΛsCDM can be discriminated on the same data.
